scripts.dev: concurrently -n tracker,bot -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w sui-lp-tracker" "npm run bot"
scripts.build:autopilot: npm run build -w @autopilot/engine && npm run build -w @autopilot/cetus && npm run build -w @autopilot/db && npm run build -w @autopilot/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w sui-lp-tracker && npm run typecheck --prefix sui-lp-autopilot
scripts.test: node scripts/check-dep-boundaries.mjs && npm run test -w sui-lp-tracker && npm run test --prefix sui-lp-autopilot
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w sui-lp-tracker && npm exec -w sui-lp-tracker -- eslint -c eslint.autopilot.config.js --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern ../sui-lp-autopilot/packages/bot/src ../sui-lp-autopilot/packages/engine/src ../sui-lp-autopilot/packages/db/src ../sui-lp-autopilot/packages/cetus/src
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build:autopilot && npm run build
